units: <cite ref="Yoma 17b">Yoma 17ᵇ</cite>, a. e. <he>שאתה פוֹנֶה</he>, v. <cite ref="Q00720"><he>פִּינָּה</he></cite>.

<cite ref="Jerusalem Talmud Avodah Zarah 3:1:2">Y. Ab. Zar. III, 42ᵇ</cite> sq. (ref. to <cite ref="Leviticus 19:4">Lev. XIX, 4</cite>) <he>אל תִּפְנֶה לעובדן</he> do not turn thy face to them to worship them; <he>אל תפנה לראותן ממש</he> it is meant literally, do not turn thy face to look at them; Sifra K’dosh. beg. <he>אל תפנה לראותם וַדַּיי</he>.

<cite ref="Leviticus 19:4">Ib.</cite> <he>תחלתם אלילים הם אם פּוֹנֶה את אחריהן וכ׳</he> at first they are ‘nothings’, but if thou turnest after them, thou wilt make them (thy) gods; <cite ref="Yalkut Shimoni on Torah 604">Yalk. Lev. 604</cite>.

<cite ref="Yalkut Shimoni on Torah 604">Ib.</cite>; <cite ref="Shabbat 149a:13">Sabb. 149ᵃ</cite> (ref. to Lev. l. c.) <he>אל תִּפְנוּ אֶל מדעתכם</he> turn not to the creation of your fancy (Rashi; anoth. interpret., v. infra); a. v. fr.

<cite ref="Eichah Rabbah 1:1">Lam. R. to I, 1</cite> <he>כיון ששתה ופ׳ לילך</he> (<cite ref="M02186"><he>מעשה</he></cite>) <cite ref="T00152"><he>רבתי</he></cite> when he had drunk and turned to go away.

<cite ref="Bereishit Rabbah 68:13">Gen. R. s. 68</cite> <he>יצא משם פ׳ זיוה פ׳ הדרה</he> when he (the righteous) goes away from a place, its splendor is gone, its glory is gone; <cite ref="Ruth Rabbah 2:12">Ruth R. to I, 7</cite>. Sifra K’dosh., ch. VIII, Par. 4, a. e. (ref. to <he>ונתתי את פני</he>, <cite ref="Leviticus 20:6">Lev. XX, 6</cite>; cmp. <cite ref="Q01148"><he>פְּנַאי</he></cite>) <he>פּוֹנֶה אני מכל וכ׳</he>, v. <cite ref="P01054"><he>עֵסֶק</he></cite>.
<cite ref="Midrash Mishlei 16:3">Midr. Prov. to XVI, 11</cite> <he>לִפְנוֹת היום</he> when the day was going away (towards evening); a. v. fr.

<cite ref="Shir HaShirim Rabbah 7:9:1">Cant. R. to VII, 9</cite> (play on <he>אח̇ש̇ד̇רפ̇נ̇יא</he>, <cite ref="Daniel 3:2">Dan. III, 2</cite>) <he>אלו ארכונות שהן נש̇ח̇ד̇ין ופ̇וני̇ן דין וכ׳</he> (not <he>נחשדין</he>) those are the officers that are bribed and turn justice in any direction; <cite ref="Daniel 3:2">ib.</cite> <he>שמה̇ד̇ר̇ין פ̇נ̇ים ופ̇ונ̇ין דין</he> who respect persons and pervert justice; a. fr.

senses.gloss: to turn aside, go out, (euphem.) to ease one’s self.
units: <cite ref="Jerusalem Talmud Sotah 1:3:4">Y. Sot. I, 16ᵈ</cite> <he>אם יִפְנֶה אחד מהן לצורכו</he> if one of them goes out for a human need.
Toh. X, 2 ופוֹנִים (Ber. 62ᵃ ונִפְנִין, Nif.).

Pesik. R. s. 42 הספינה … ולא תטריח עליה לִפְנוֹתָהּ (not הטריח) thy friend’s ship has been seized (for public service), and wilt thou not take pains to release it? ועכשיו של אחרים הוא פוֹנֶה ושלו אינה נפנית and now he releases other men’s ships, and shall not his be released.?—Part. pass. פָּנוּי; f. פְּנוּיָה vacant, empty, free.

<cite ref="Berakhot 43a:9">Ber. 43ᵃ</cite> <he>אין בית הבליעה פ׳</he> his œsophagus is not free (which makes speaking dangerous). Y. Kil. III, beg. 28ᶜ <he>אי אפשר … נקב אחד פ׳ וכ׳</he> it is not possible that there should not be one cavity free for planting &c.; <cite ref="Jerusalem Talmud Shabbat 9:2:3">Y. Sabb. IX, 11ᵈ</cite> bot. <he>אפשר … פניי</he> (corr. acc.).
<cite ref="Bamidbar Rabbah 14:4">Num. R. s. 14</cite> <he>והיה הבית פ׳</he> and the house was empty (none at home); a. fr.—V. <cite ref="Q01167"><he>פָּנוּי</he></cite>.

<cite ref="Mishnah Shabbat 3:5">Sabb. III, 5</cite> <he>המיחם שפִּינָּהוּ וכ׳</he> in the kettle which one has emptied (or: which one has removed from the oven) &c.; <cite ref="Shabbat 41a:2">ib. 41ᵃ</cite> <he>המיחם שפ׳ ממנו מים וכ׳</he> in the kettle out of which one has removed the hot water.

<cite ref="Mishnah Shabbat 18:1">Ib. XVIII, 1</cite> <he>מְפַנִּין אפי׳ וכ׳</he> you may clear away (on the Sabbath) even four or five piles … to make room for guests. Y. Gitt. VIII, 49ᵈ top <he>אם … איש מְפַנֶּה</he> if the court belongs to the wife, the husband (after divorce) must vacate it, <he>ושל איש אשה מְפַנָּה</he> and if it belongs to the husband, the wife must vacate it; <he>מי מפנה מפני מי</he> which of them must vacate it for the other? <cite ref="Taanit 21a:8">Taan. 21ᵃ</cite> <he>בקשו תלמידיו לפַנּוֹת את וכ׳</he> his disciples wanted to move his bed first and then his furniture; <he>פַּנּוּ את הכלים וכ׳</he> move the furniture first.
<cite ref="Pirkei Avot 3:4">Ab. III, 4</cite> <he>מפנה לבו לבטלה</he> empties his heart (of serious thoughts to make room) for frivolous subjects.

<cite ref="Shabbat 149a:13">Sabb. 149ᵃ</cite> (ref. to <cite ref="Leviticus 19:4">Lev. XIX, 4</cite>, v. supra) <he>אל תְּפַנוּ אֵל מדעתכם</he> do not remove God from your minds (to make room for idols).

<cite ref="Bava Kamma 81b:16">B. Kam. 81ᵇ</cite> <he>מְפַנֵּיהוּ לשדה וכ׳</he> he must remove the corpse to &c. Y. Maasr. II, 49ᵈ <he>רוצה אדם לפנות עסקיו וכ׳</he> (ed. Krot. <he>רוצה הוא אדם לפנע</he>; ed. Zyt. <he>לפלה</he>, corr. acc.) a man is anxious to dispose of his goods in the first place he strikes &c.; a. fr.
<cite ref="Leviticus 6">Vayikra 6</cite> <he>פ׳ לקרתני ולבן פלטרין וכ׳</he> he acquitted the commoner, but convicted the courtier.
<cite ref="Leviticus 6">Ib.</cite> <he>לקרתני פִּנִּיתִי וכ׳</he> I acquitted the commoner, because he knows not the royal customs; a. fr.

<cite ref="Midrash Tehillim 18:9">Midr. Till. to Ps. XVIII, 5</cite> <he>נִפְנֵיתִי לכאן וכ׳</he> I turned in all directions, and there is no redeemer but thee; <cite ref="Yalkut Shimoni on Nach 157">Yalk. Sam. 157</cite>; a. e.
<cite ref="Bereishit Rabbah 98">Gen. R. s. 98</cite> <he>שהיה נ׳ מן העולם</he> who was going to die.
<cite ref="Tosefta Parah 3:8">Tosef. Par. III</cite> (<cite ref="Tosefta Parah 2:8">II</cite>), 8 <he>נ׳ בני</he> my son is dead (v. infra); a. e.

senses.gloss: to be free, at leisure. Ib. לכשאֶפָּנֶה לך when I shall have leisure for thee, i.e. I shall take revenge on thee, when opportunity offers; אמר לו כשתִּפָּנֶה said he to him, when thou shalt be at leisure (or when thou shalt be dead, v. supra); ib. (Vers. of R. S. to Par. III, 8) לא נ׳ בני שהעריב שמשו my son has found no leisure (to take revenge), for his sun has set (he is dead).
units: <cite ref="Pirkei Avot 2:4">Ab. II, 4</cite> <he>אל תאמר לכשאפנה אשנה שמא לא תפנה</he> say not, when I shall be at leisure, I will study; may be thou wilt never find leisure; a. fr.

<cite ref="Shabbat 82a:5">Sabb. 82ᵃ</cite> <he>הנצרך לִפָּנוֹת ואינו נפנה</he> (Alf. <he>להִפָּנוֹת</he>) he who feels the want of easing himself, and is not relieved; <cite ref="Shabbat 82a:5">ib.</cite> <he>הנצרך ליפנות ואינו יכול ליפנות</he>.
<cite ref="Berakhot 62a:11">Ber. 62ᵃ</cite> <he>ונִפְנִין</he>, v. supra; a. fr.

senses.gloss: to be released. Pesik. R. l. c., v. supra.

units: <cite ref="Mishnah Yevamot 3:5">Yeb. III, 5</cite> <he>שלשה אחין … ואחד מ׳</he> three brothers two of whom were married to two sisters, and one is free (unmarried or married to one who is a stranger to his brothers’ wives); Y. ib. III, 4ᵈ top; a. e.—
senses.label: a

senses.gloss: (dialectical exegesis) free for interpretation, unnecessary for the plain sense or context.
units: Nidd. 22ᵇ וייצר מ׳ משני צדדין מ׳ … ומ׳ גבי בהמה vayitser is free for interpretation on both sides, it is free with regard to man (Gen. II, 7, because man’s creation is mentioned in ויברא, ib. I, 27), and free with regard to beasts (ib. II, 19, their creation being stated in ויעש, ib. I, 25). Ib. כל גזירה שוה שאינה מוּפְנָה כל עיקר וכ׳ analogous words which are not entirely free (in both texts) cannot be made the basis for interpretation as g’zerah shavah (v. גְּזֵרָה). Ib. מ׳ מצד אחד free in one of the texts; Sabb. 64ᵃ; a. fr.
senses.label: b

senses.gloss: to be vacated, cleared, removed. Y. Naz. IX, 57ᵈ bot. כל הקברות מִתְפַּנִּין וכ׳ all graves may be vacated (transferred), except &c.; Treat. S’maḥ. ch. XIV.
to be released. Pesik. R. l. c. כדי הוא (ש)תִּיתְפִּנֶּה he deserves it to have his ship released (ed. Prag כדי הוא שיִתְפַּנֶּה he deserves to be released).
